faq.title: Questions, <accent>Answered Honestly</accent>
faq.subtitle: The things flatmates actually ask before they convince the fourth member to sign up.

what.a: MessMate is a free mess management app for shared living in Bangladesh. It replaces notebooks and spreadsheets with a calm dashboard for meal tracking, expenses, deposits, and automatic month-end accounting.

free.a: Yes. MessMate is 100% free to use, and there are no plans to charge for the core features. There is no pricing page, no trial window, no card asked — just create an account and go.

accounting.q: Do I need to know accounting to use it?
accounting.a: Not at all. MessMate computes the meal rate, each member's bill, and final balances automatically using total expenses divided by total meals. You just log what happened; the math is done for you.

join.q: How do members join my mess?
join.a: Create a mess and you get a unique, secure join code. Each flatmate signs up, enters the code, and is in — no approvals, no spreadsheets, no delays.

months.a: Months are manual: the mess runs open, and when the month ends a manager closes it. The month is frozen and archived, a new month opens, and balances carry forward automatically.

manager.a: The person who creates the mess is the first manager and can promote one more. MessMate allows up to two managers per mess, both with the same equal permissions.

balances.q: What happens to balances at month-end?
balances.a: A positive balance rolls forward as part of your next deposit. A negative balance becomes an individual expense you settle. Every month ends with a clear, fair number for everyone.

visible.a: Yes — that's the point. Meal rates, deposits, expenses, balances, and the full activity history are visible to every member of the mess. Nothing hides behind a manager's desk.

accounting.title: One Formula. <accent>Every Member Sees It.</accent>
accounting.subtitle: MessMate does the month-end that used to take a calculator and a whiteboard — with the math fully visible to everyone in the mess.
accounting.p1: Meal Rate is total spend divided by meals — computed instantly, updated live.
accounting.p2: Each member's bill is just their meals multiplied by the rate.
accounting.p3: Deposits are tracked per member, so paying up is explicit and checkable.
accounting.p4: Final balance = deposits paid minus meal share; carried forward clearly month to month.
accounting.rollNote: Closing the month rolls balances forward

monthFlow.title: One Clean Loop, <accent>Every Single Month</accent>
monthFlow.subtitle: MessMate is built around a simple monthly rhythm that matches how messes actually run — open, fill, calculate, close, repeat.

current.title: Current Month
current.description: Meals, expenses and deposits are logged live against the open month.

calculate.title: Calculate
calculate.description: Meal rate, member bills and net balances are computed automatically.

close.title: Close & Archive
close.description: A manager closes the month; it becomes a frozen, shareable record.

start.title: Start New Month
start.description: A fresh month opens right away — no setup, no resets, no confusion.

carry.title: Carry Forward
carry.description: Positive balances roll into deposits. Negative balances become individual expenses.

monthFlow.note: Balance carried forward: if you're in credit it becomes your next deposit; if you owe, it becomes an individual expense to settle. Fair to everyone, every month.

technology.title: Stack You Can <accent>Trust</accent>
technology.subtitle: A modern, deliberately boring stack — fast to ship, easy to keep honest, and pleasant to maintain. No bloat, no mystery.

activity.title: Every Action Leaves a <accent>Trace</accent>
activity.subtitle: Activity history is built into the heart of MessMate, not bolted on. Every meal edit, expense, deposit, and month transition is logged and visible to the whole mess.
activity.body1: That means no more “I never saw that entry” — because the record is public to your mess and stamped with who did what and when.
activity.body2: Role changes are logged too. If a manager is added or removed, the mess can see exactly when it happened. Accountability isn't an afterthought.
activity.audit: Built-in audit trail. You can audit the whole month before you close it — from the same screen.
